# Pipeline tests (cmake/RestTests.cmake): executable pipelinesTests, label
# pipelines. Each test runs restManager with the YAML of the examples on the
# data (real, and simulated with restG4) of rest-common-data (downloaded by URL,
# cached in the work directory) and compares the analysis tree of the outputs
# with a reference of reference/ (REST_UPDATE_REFERENCE=1 writes the references
# instead); the readouts of the examples are generated by the tests
rest_add_tests(pipelines RestTools ${DETECTOR_LIB})
target_compile_definitions(
  pipelinesTests PRIVATE REPOSITORY_DIR="${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}"
                         RESTMANAGER_EXECUTABLE="$<TARGET_FILE:restManager>")
add_dependencies(pipelinesTests restManager)
